explain_task.question: Using the revised `src/current_heuristic.py`, `src/formulation.tex`, and the LP-relaxation/MIP solver records, explain exactly why the objective rises from 3360.0 in the original model to 3540.0 in the revised one even though running A3 triggers a cleaning loss on Type A capacity. Your answer must name the exact added code variables and constraints responsible for the +180 change, trace them to the literal CSV field names `cold_chain_bonus_threshold_kg`, `cold_chain_bonus_yuan`, `type_A_cleaning_loss_if_A3`, and `cap_A_shared`, and map them to the business-brief terms “cold-chain allowance” and “cleaning block.” Also identify which revised LP-relaxation constraints are binding and have nonzero duals, interpret the shadow price on the bonus-threshold constraint in business terms, and explain why that marginal value cannot be linearly extrapolated to larger threshold changes in the integer model.
